title: Peace comes through serving the True Guru
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 85
summary: The shabad starts by joining service, peace, and the treasure of the True Name. It deepens through self-recognition, inner light, truthfulness, and praise that returns body and soul to the Lord.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person wanting peace without surrendering the center seat. Reach for it before self-justification or image-management takes over, and it will press peace back through service, recognition, and praise.
takeaway: Serve first, and let peace expose the self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sukh paiaa sach naam gunataas ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained. The True Name is the Treasure of Excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmatee aap pachhaaniaa raam naam paragaas ||
lines.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and recognize your own self; the Divine Light of the Lord's Name shall shine within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sach kamaavanaa vaddiaaiee vadde paas ||
lines.translation: The true ones practice Truth; greatness rests in the Great Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kaa sifat kare aradhaas ||
lines.translation: Body, soul and all things belong to the Lord-praise Him, and offer your prayers to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabadh saalaahanaa sukhe sukh nivaas ||
lines.translation: Sing the Praises of the True Lord through the Word of His Shabad, and you shall abide in the peace of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam manai maeh bin naavai dhirag jeevaas ||
lines.translation: You may practice chanting, penance and austere self-discipline within your mind, but without the Name, life is useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naau paieeaai manmukh moh vinaas ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained, while the self-willed manmukh wastes away in emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too(n) naanak teraa dhaas ||2||
lines.translation: Please protect me, by the Pleasure of Your Will. Nanak is Your slave. ||2||

structure: The shabad begins by making service the doorway into peace and the Name's treasure.
From there it lets the Guru's teaching expose the self and light it from within.
The closing movement rests by returning body, soul, and praise to the Lord who held them all along.
